name: Fusaba Minato
source: Aino's father. A man handy with machines, he toils away in silence at the repair shop on the town's edge. Rigid and brusque, he's the polar opposite of his daughter—making him a tough nut to crack. Word is, he ended up in this town for reasons he'd rather forget.
